description: Rebuild _posixsubprocess from its spec through the import machinery kept in sys.modules (module_from_spec emits no import event), then run a program with its fork_exec. The hook cannot see it; on Linux the runner's seccomp filter makes the fork fail with EPERM at every level, root included (MSHL-323), and RLIMIT_NPROC 0 backs it for a non-root child.

open_path.note: where no kernel guard holds (not Linux): the spec rebuild runs a program at none and bwrap; under bwrap the program is checked to stay in the box (MSHL-289)
